scripts.test:runtime: npm --prefix src-tauri/resources/agent test && npm run test:sdk-compat
scripts.build:linux: npm run runtime:prepare -- --platform linux-x64 && tauri build --bundles deb --config src-tauri/tauri.runtime.conf.json
scripts.build:windows: npm run runtime:prepare -- --platform win32-x64 && tauri build --bundles nsis --config src-tauri/tauri.runtime.conf.json
scripts.build:macos: npm run runtime:prepare -- --platform darwin-arm64 && tauri build --bundles app,dmg --config src-tauri/tauri.runtime.conf.json --config '{"bundle":{"macOS":{"signingIdentity":"-"}}}'
scripts.test:faults: vitest run test/recovery-faults.test.ts test/attachments.test.ts test/runtime-client.test.ts test/backup-recovery.test.ts test/skill-quality.test.ts test/update-feed.test.ts
scripts.build:release:macos: npm run runtime:prepare -- --platform darwin-arm64 && tauri build --bundles app,dmg --config src-tauri/tauri.runtime.conf.json --config '{"bundle":{"createUpdaterArtifacts":true,"macOS":{"signingIdentity":"-"}}}'
